input.query:
SELECT
  r.id AS refund_id,
  r.amount_cents,
  r.reason,
  r.status,
  r.requested_at,
  r.evidence_submitted,
  oi.id AS order_item_id,
  oi.quantity,
  oi.unit_price_cents,
  o.id AS order_id,
  o.order_date,
  o.status AS order_status,
  p.name AS product_name,
  p.sku,
  p.category,
  c.name AS customer_name
FROM refunds r
JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.name ILIKE 'Ava Thompson'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%Bluetooth Headphones%'
input.intent: Find the refund record for Ava Thompson's Bluetooth Headphones order

output.sql_executed: SELECT r.id AS refund_id, r.amount_cents, r.reason, r.status, r.requested_at, r.evidence_submitted, oi.id AS order_item_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_cents, o.id AS order_id, o.order_date, o.status AS order_status, p.name AS product_name, p.sku, p.category, c.name AS customer_name FROM refunds AS r JOIN order_items AS oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.name ILIKE 'Ava Thompson' AND p.name ILIKE '%Bluetooth Headphones%' LIMIT 500

output.content:
Damaged in Shipping

Items returned under the `damaged_shipping` reason code have no time limit for return. A refund request under the `damaged_shipping` reason code requires supporting photo evidence before the refund can be processed.

Evidence is tracked structurally as `refunds.evidence_submitted` (boolean) — this confirms evidence was provided, not that the evidence is valid; validity review is a manual/out-of-scope step for Part 1.

Defective Items

Items returned under the `defective` reason code may be refunded up to 90 days from the purchase date. The 90-day window for a `defective` refund applies regardless of the standard 30-day return window, and takes precedence over the standard 30-day return window when the two conflict.

Approval Threshold

A refund with an amount greater than $200 requires manager approval before the refund can be processed. The $200 approval threshold applies regardless of the refund's reason code.
